note: Read by tools/progress_tracker.py (format in docs/tracker.md). Only facts from the repo: a metric's total stays null ('not measured yet') until the split (ER-003) and the census (ER-004) give real counts; never write an estimate as a total. Every metric, milestone and task has a 'track': decomp, recomp, port, assets or other. Statuses: milestones and phase items use Not started / In progress / Complete; ER tasks use Queued / In progress / Waiting / Done.

tracks.name: Decomp
tracks.summary: Matching decompilation of the EE ELF (SLUS_200.15, 2,485,924 bytes) into C that rebuilds byte-identical. Totals come from the split (ER-003) and the census (ER-004); nothing is measured yet. IOP modules are mostly Sony's (identified, not decompiled).

metrics.name: Functions matched (EE ELF)
metrics.notes: Matched = C placed in src/ and proven by the byte-identical build (make regress: whole-ELF SHA-1 + func_check, nothing masked); goal: true 100% (every function in C, NON_MATCHING 0), LuciDin 17 Nov 2026. Done 127 = empty functions splat wrote as C. Total 3,609 = the 3,606 function symbols func_check counts (4 crt0, 3,475 INCLUDE_ASM, 127 C) + 3 INCLUDE_ASM blocks splat labels as data (func_001D73D0, func_001D7658, func_001DECA0, COP2/VU0-style words), which func_check does not count but still need C. ER-004 may revise.

metrics.name: Code bytes matched (EE ELF .text)
metrics.notes: ER-003: .text 0xF0354 bytes; done = the 127 empty C functions (8 bytes each).

metrics.name: SDK library functions identified
metrics.notes: ER-004 census: 775 units in SDK regions (libgraph..libkernl tail, docs/census.md 4.1); 623 in Confirmed regions, 152 in Unconfirmed ones (sdk-vudev, libvu0, libipu, libsdr, libgcc, libkernl tail). Seam windows can move a few functions. done = matched SDK functions (0 beyond 2 empty ones counted in m-dec-funcs).
